name: Expansive Collective [Psionic]
body:
The power of your collective is unaffected by your
other dabblings.

Prerequisite: Collective class feature, spirit of many class feature.

Benefit: When calculating the range and number of creatures which may be joined to your collective, use your total Hit Dice instead of your class level.
